note: Siege art (W-29). objects[]: every single sprite (anchor = foot; tileOrigin = px of the top vertex of the footprint's north tile: draw at that tile's top vertex minus tileOrigin; metres = h above the footprint diamond basePx). engines[]: per facing (e +x, s +y, w -x, n -y: the way the ram / thrower points) footprint and states (buildOrder + progress as buildings, then damaged, destroyed); done = built and moving. Ram is layered: states = BACK sprite, front = FRONT sprite (roof, near side): draw back, the crew at crew[] (tile offsets from the footprint NW corner), then front. anims[facing]: horizontal strips (frame n at x = n * frame.w), drawn at their own tileOrigin: ram swing (back layer; hitFrame = the log fully out), thrower throw (frame 0 = cocked + loaded; releaseFrame: spawn stone-shot at release[facing], tile offsets + zM). ladders: see ladders.note. rubble[]: walkable heaps for breached wall tiles (wall run axis, the wall's depth across; variants a/b alternate along a run) and fallen towers. fx[]: looping strips with an anchor (flames and smoke: the anchor sits on the burning point; scorch decals on the ground). Colours = tiles.json palette + palette.

engines.note: Rams node: wet hides to the ground (crew hidden, missiles x0.3), iron-scaled front bay, iron-plated gable, iron ram's head
Carpenter node: a wheeled hide-faced screen; front = the screen when it faces e or s (in front of the crew), else it is in the back sprite. Stops 60% of frontal missiles for the men behind
Artillerist node: torsion bolt thrower on a pedestal; shoot frame 0 = cocked and loaded = the done sprite; spawn the bolt projectile at release[facing] on releaseFrame

Poliorcetes node: crew push from inside the open ground storey (draw them between back and front); drawbridge hinged on the facing side at bridgeM (lands on a stone wall's parapet, 5.97 m), bridge anim lowers it (last frame = docked); men cross at bridgeM onto the walk

ladders.note: pieces <target>-<side>: on the ladder's own tile, leaning on the wall face on that side (n -y, e +x, s +y, w -x; inside or outside = the side), foot footM from the face, head at topM (walk + parapet + 0.3 m); a climber at height z stands footM x (1 - z / topM) out from the face. -down: knocked down, lying broken away from the wall (spills ~3 tiles out). pushOff: the fall from raised to down. carry: lying flat, drawn carryPx above the ground over its footprint, bearers = tile offsets of the carrying men.

fireNote: Fire v2 (procedural, fire.mjs). Emitters, not stickers: a burning wall tile gets many tongue-<s|m|l>-<a|b|c> at their density.perTile[intensity] (low k < 0.34, medium < 0.67, high), each with a seed fixed per (piece, tile, i): shape = seed % 3, a spot u = rand along the tile's visible face (on the face plane, not the tile centre), height z = zMax * rand^2 (most at the foot, a few high: zMax = 0.25 / 0.6 / 0.95 of the wood's height at low / medium / high; at high 1-2 l tongues at the top edge), frame = (floor(now * fps / 1000) + seed * 5) % frames (phase offsets: never in step). Draw at scale 1 (intensity changes count and size, never scale), the anchor on the wood, depth just in front of the face. Per tile also: a fire-sheet-<run axis>-<m at medium | l at high> at the foot (anchor = the face start, z 0; drawn before the tongues), 1 heat-glow (ground, add), embers per density (add, at the flames' top), smoke-wisp-a|b per density (alpha per intensity, flipX for wind -x). Building footprint: treat each visible face as a wall run of its tiles (heightM of the piece), plus 2-3 tongues on the roof/platform edge at high. Charring: char[] overlays drawn over the kit frame (same frame, tileOrigin): scorch at low, charred at medium, smoulder at high and while dying; after the fire: smoulder fx 2 per tile (+ smoke-wisp-b at alpha 0.3 per 2 tiles) for ~20 s with the smoulder overlay, then charred. Mock-up: fire-preview.mjs places exactly this. flame-s/m/l: legacy clusters for the old one-per-tile placement.
